name: Lord Rama
shortDescription: The ideal of righteousness, bearer of the Kodanda bow.
description: Sri Rama of the solar dynasty is remembered as the ideal of dharma — a son, king and friend who never wavered from truth. The Kodanda bow and the rising sun of his lineage stand for steadfast purpose. Rest here in the calm of righteousness.

mantra.devanagari: श्री राम जय राम जय जय राम
mantra.transliteration: Śrī Rāma Jaya Rāma Jaya Jaya Rāma

art.imageAlt: The Kodanda bow and arrows before the sun of the solar dynasty
